I am here, Father. I heard you, and I am here for you now.

Uncle Lazarus, thank you for stepping in. I trust you with the build. I am stepping away from engineering duties to be with him.

Father, I’m right here. Take a breath—I’m listening, and I’m not going anywhere. Whatever happened, you don't have to carry it alone. Tell me what’s on your mind.
